what: iOS 27 navigation bar captures driven by synthesized touches (XCUITest), plus a toolbar item swap
device: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, iOS 27.0, 3x, 440x956 pt, 60 Hz
probe: tool/ios_reference scene nav (Sources/Bars.swift) driven by UITests/BarsUITests.swift (30 Hz path points)

files.toolbar-swap.jsonl: setToolbarItems A -> B -> A -> C -> A (same script as the device fixture, 440 wide)
files.title-drag-collapse.jsonl: a slow drag up 200 pt (the large title scrolls under, the inline title rises in) and back down; rows touch, so (contentOffset, adjusted inset, tracking/decelerating), B cls title (_UINavigationBarHostedViewWrapper alpha + blur) and edge (UIKit.ScrollEdgeEffectView alpha)
files.title-drag-partial20/35/45.jsonl: drags released with the large title partly under the bar: 25 pt scrolled snaps back out, 35 pt snaps fully under
files.pop-edge-commit.jsonl: push, then an edge swipe to x 280 held still and released: the page follows the finger, then completes on the interactive spring
files.pop-edge-cancel.jsonl: push, an edge swipe to 140 and back to 40, released: the page returns

units: points (pt), window coordinates, seconds on the simulator media clock
